items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I asked Jay would he teach me how to write for the group... I learned a whole lot from Jay... Jay taught me the changes on the piano... without Jay McShann, I don't know what would have happened, because he taught me the changes to most of the tunes
